prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Sign-in hints, interactive wait screen flows and tips, a preset customization fallback flow, and story screen sequence reordering were helpful.
Hints outside sign-in, sign-in step reordering, and most wait screen info updates showed no clear effect.
Layout changes, new screens, and copy updates showed no clear effect or significantly hurt performance.
Predictions were too high for failed or harmful changes, overestimating gains for tests that saw no clear effect or severe drops.
Predictions were too low for winning sequence reorderings and interactive waiting flows that were expected to fail.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Launch Readiness Check Screen: Add a dedicated readiness check screen right before finish to verify desktop pet rendering and window permissions. (why: Support received 3 separate bug reports stating pets fail to show on desktop or the app fails to open after onboarding.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Multi-Step Photo Preview Verification Flow: Add an interactive preview and validation flow on the photo upload screen before custom pet generation starts. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or wrong-looking visual outputs.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Memory Sign-In Hint: Add a direct hint under sign-in buttons explaining that logging into an existing account restores saved pets. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Initialization Wait Stage Timer: Display explicit stage timers and rendering status on the waiting screen as the desktop pet initializes. (why: Waiting step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, indicating users idle during generation.)
4: [choose_path, hint] Path Selection Trait Preview Callout: Add personality and desktop interaction trait callouts directly on the path selection cards. (why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control or interact with the pet.)
5: [home, notification] Background Rendering Desktop Ready Alert: Include a notification prompt on the waiting screen letting users opt into a desktop alert when their pet is ready. (why: Waiting stage mean time is 2336s, showing that users switch away while waiting for rendering.)
6: [sign_in, layout] Centered Single-Tap Quick Sign-In Layout: Reframe the sign-in screen into a centered layout highlighting fast social sign-in options. (why: Sign-in drop-off is nearly 20% and mean time takes 567s, suggesting friction in standard authentication.)

scores.note: New screens at finish step historically hurt conversion significantly (-14.4%).
Interactive adoption flows have a strong track record of success (+3.1%).
Sign-in hints supported by strong evidence perform reliably well (+2.8%).
Wait info updates yield modest improvements (+1.5%) with limited confidence.
Hints outside sign-in tend to be ineffective or slightly negative (-0.8%).
Addresses long wait times but push notification prompts have uncertain lift.
Sign-in layout changes show no clear effect in previous tests (0.0%).
